title: REQ · Stable documented JSON export type with round id, ids, authors, content and timestamps
summary: Export JSON type carries round id and per-contribution id, author, content, timestamp, documented
description: Context: no export type exists. Desired behavior: exported Export and ExportContribution structs with explicit json tags and doc comments describing the format and its version. Expected result: marshalling yields a stable shape. Why: the devion handoff consumes it.
acceptance_criteria: Given an Export, when json.Marshal runs, then keys include version, world_id, round_id, contributions
Given an ExportContribution, when marshalled, then keys are id, author, content, created_at with RFC3339 time
Given the types, when read, then each has a doc comment
technical_constraints: Only stdlib and existing contribution package
